notes.title: Minor Update
notes.content:
- Fixing issue where number of collectables was wrongly reported for achievement purposes.
- Added the check for the achievements at the start of the game for people whose collectable count was previously corrupted by the other issue in this patch.

notes.title: GDWC Announcement
notes.content:
[h1]Hello everyone! [/h1]

For those of you who knew about it (and those of you who didn't) we were nominated for two categories on the GDWC 2023 Awards.

We were nominated for both the Studio Award and the Action Award!

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41037484/ef78fde1524b68ae8277133c4138de72a3f42d77.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41037484/16ee3609123beb0c18eead604d6ef4531a7f4bee.png[/img][/url]

The better news is that we won the Studio Award!  We would want to thank the organization and the other nominees!

Here is the link for the awards ceremony if any of you want to check it out:
[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NPT1Nldc-aI]Awards Ceremony YouTube Video[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41037484/7bb7a7ccadc08b8849a884b1a160e641c5b23edd.png[/img]

notes.title: Minor Update
notes.content:
- Fixing issue calculating the time that gets displayed on the save slots menu.
- Fixing issue related to leaderboards and using multiple devices with the same steam account.
- Fixing minor visual issue with the intro cinematic.

notes.title: Minor Update
notes.content:
- Fixing softlock issue on level 3.
- Fixing problem related to unlocking Show Off achievement

notes.title: Patch Notes:
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixing issue with leaderboards score not being reported properly.
[*] Fixing issues with several achievements that were not being unlocked under certain circumstances.
[*] Fixing issues with the cloud save.
[*] Adding level progression percentage on the pause menu.
[*] Balancing difficulty of several sections of the game.
[*] Fixing several checkpoints problems, specially on the hard mode.
[*] Fixing stun mechanic problem against one of the bosses.
[*] Several bug fixes related to enemies or hazards. 
[*] Improving level decorations, specially on levels 5,6,7 and 8. 
[/list]

notes.title: Launch Hotfixes
notes.content:
Fixes:

- Fixed an issue where achievements were not being reported to Steam.
- Made it so previously gotten achievements that were not reported, will be reported.
- Fixed so leaderboards show the user's name correctly on future time submissions.

Known Issues:

- These issues still present on MacOS, will be fixed on a future update.
